domains.name: Maternal Complications
domains.summary: Indicators of maternal complications during delivery such as perineal laceration, uterine rupture, and unplanned hysterectomy.

domains.name: Maternal Morbidity
domains.summary: Indicator whether any maternal morbidity was checked and a flag for no maternal morbidity being reported.

domains.name: Delivery Method
domains.summary: Recode of the delivery method including vaginal, primary or repeat cesarean sections.

domains.name: APGAR Scores
domains.summary: Ten-minute and five-minute APGAR scores and their recodes for assessing newborn health at birth.

domains.name: Reporting Flags
domains.summary: Flags indicating whether various data points such as the five-minute APGAR score, payment source, and plurality were reported.

domains.name: Mother Transfer
domains.summary: Indicator of whether the mother was transferred to another facility during delivery.

domains.name: Payment Source
domains.summary: Source and recode of payment for medical services, including Medicaid, private insurance, self-pay, and others.

domains.name: Last Menstrual Period
domains.summary: Month and year of the last menstrual period used to estimate gestational age.
